channel.title: Book Summaries: Language and Linguistics
channel.description: Discover comprehensive book summaries covering self-help, business, psychology, relationships, productivity, and classic novels. Get key insights and takeaways from bestselling books in minutes.

item.title: The Language Instinct by Steven Pinker
item.description: Pinker explains language as an evolved human capacity, from children's grammar and speech perception to the debate over innate rules.

item.title: The Unfolding of Language by Guy Deutscher
item.description: How erosion, metaphor, and analogy turn everyday speech into complex grammar, and what these changes suggest about early language.

item.title: Through the Language Glass by Guy Deutscher
item.description: How language can train attention to color, direction, and grammatical gender, without setting the limits of thought.
